_comment: Token prices in $/MTok, per provider. usage-report.py reads this file; editing it changes the report without touching the parser. A family key matches by substring against the model name, longest key first, so 'gpt-5.6-sol' wins over 'gpt-5.6'. cache_write_multiplier and cache_read_multiplier are applied to the input price. Set rates_verified to false for a provider whose numbers you have not checked against the vendor's current price list — the report then labels its cost column as an estimate instead of presenting a guess as a fact.

codex._rates_note: Placeholders scaled to the tier each model serves, not published rates. Until someone checks them against the current OpenAI price list and flips rates_verified, treat the Codex cost column as relative weight between tiers and read the token columns as the real measurement.
